reply_text:
I found five new dated predictions from 2026, all from one interview. I also confirmed one claim you already have. The rest of the year's coverage I opened had no new dated predictions.

**New: the Nebius Science interview** (Stepan Kravchenko, published 13 July 2026, a printed question-and-answer). I opened this page myself and the quotes in the JSON are copied from it. The site prints non-breaking spaces between words, and I've written them as normal spaces. The page I got back was cut off before the end, so anything later in the interview is unchecked. In it LeCun:
- expects "another revolution" that takes AI into real-world things "in the next four years or so";
- puts AI's grasp of the physical world at about cat or rat level by 2030. The year 2030 comes from the interviewer's question, not from him.
- expects useful world-model applications "within two to three years";
- says AMI will have prototypes "within a year or so." This is close to your recorded 15 May claims about results within 18 months, but it was said on a different occasion, so I left it unmarked. You may decide it repeats one of them.
- answers "Yes, entirely possible" when asked whether fully self-driving (level-5) cars are possible by 2030. Again the year is the interviewer's.

**Already recorded:** the Brown University lecture quote ("within five years") is on Brown's own news page dated 1 April 2026. It is a news write-up, not a transcript, and it matches your `2026-04-01-lecun-not-human-level-within-five-years.toml`.

**Opened, nothing dated:** the Seoul press briefing of 12 October (Kyunghyang Shinmun and Korea Herald) and the Fortune interview of 1 October. In the briefing he said there will be no sudden moment when a superhuman AI appears, but gave no date. In Fortune he would only say AMI's first product is coming "soon."

**Not checked:** I only saw search snippets for the New Delhi AI Impact Summit (February), VivaTech (17 June), Axios (4 May) and MIT Technology Review (22 January). I did not open those pages, so they are not quoted and the January claims are not re-confirmed here. The Medium interview would not open.
